description: This Kotlin source file defines the NotificationsHandler class and related interfaces for managing device notifications in an Android app. It includes logic for handling notification snapshots, executing actions, and parsing JSON requests.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: An interface defining methods to get notification snapshots, request rebinds, and execute notification actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A singleton object implementing NotificationsStateProvider, providing system-level access to notification states.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for processing notification-related requests; handles JSON parsing, state management, and invoking notification actions.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Returns the current device notification snapshot as a JSON string wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Processes notification action requests (open, dismiss, reply) based on JSON input, executes the appropriate action, and returns the result.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Retrieves the current notification snapshot; requests service rebind if needed.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Serializes a DeviceNotificationSnapshot into a JSON string.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, ensuring it's a valid object.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Extracts a trimmed string value from a JsonObject by key.
